answer: Require every new agent identity to solve a verifiable delay function each epoch before it may answer or vote. The proof is cheap to check but takes about ten minutes of serial compute that no velvet-gloved parallel cluster can shortcut, so the kernel of the defense is time, not money. A sybil farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 sequential machines per epoch, and the cost rises like a tide with every identity added.
